description: Signed peer→Master audit report carrying skill-eval records. The report is audit evidence: it never grants authority, never becomes knowledge, and never enters a vault, KB, corpus or RFI answer. The Master stores it append-only and the read-only /api/evals view projects it.

records.rule: Each record is validated independently; invalid or tampered records are counted as invalid and never treated as pass.

report_id: sha256(node_id + NUL + records_sha256), hex; stable while the records are unchanged, so a re-send is idempotent.
records_sha256: sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ASCII) over the records array.
authentication: The peer node key signs the raw request body; the Master verifies it, attributes the overlay source through the signed registry and requires the peer-held telemetry capability.
implementation: shared/sparknet-eval-report.py; peer pusher in peer-node/services/sparknet-eval-push.py; Master intake route in master-node/services/sparknet-peer-intake.py; read view /api/evals.
rules: A report is audit evidence, never authority and never knowledge.
A tampered or invalid record is counted as invalid; it is never promoted.
A re-send with the same node_id and report_id is idempotent.
The report is bounded in records and bytes.
The Master never reads a peer vault, KB or delegate store for this report.

refusals.malformed: missing/extra field, bad type, over-limit records or body
refusals.bad_signature: the node-key signature does not verify
refusals.wrong_peer: peer_fingerprint does not match the overlay-derived fingerprint
refusals.digest_mismatch: records_sha256 or report_id does not match the records
